## Supplemental Figure 1D
```{python results = 'hold', supp_1D}
tissue_palette = {
    "Ascites": "#2278B5",
    "Blood": "#D62A28",
    "Peritoneal": "#00D2D5"
}

tissue_dict = {
    'blood': 'Blood',
    'ascites': 'Ascites',
    'peritoneal': 'Peritoneal'
}

# Load single-cell object
global_data = pg.read_input(
    '/projects/home/tlchan/projects/ascites/w_peritoneal/clusterings/ascites_combo_lineage_R3_300mg_20pm_harm_channel_multi_res/0.3/data/pseudobulk/ascites_combo_lineage_R3_300mg_20pm_harm_channel_0_3_complete_with_pb.zarr.zip')

# Rename labels for plot
pg.annotate(global_data, 'Tissue', 'tissue_type', tissue_dict)

fig = python_functions.plot_umap(lin_data=global_data,
                                 color="Tissue",
                                 palette=tissue_palette)

plt.show()
# plt.savefig("/projects/home/tlchan/fig_panels/supp_1d.pdf")
plt.close(fig)
```

## Supplemental Figure 1E
```{r message = F, results = F, warning = F, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 8, supp_1E}
lineage_palette <- list("B/Plasma cells" = "#FF0029",
                        "CD4 T cells" = "#377EB8",
                        "CD8 T/NK cells" = "#66A61E",
                        "Dendritic cells" = "#984EA3",
                        "Mono/Macs" = "#00D2D5")

global_lineage <- read.csv('/projects/home/tlchan/projects/ascites/results/abundance/w_peritoneal/global_lineage_counts.csv')

global_lineage <- global_lineage %>%
    filter(Lineage != "Non-immune cells") %>%
    group_by(Lineage, Tissue_Type) %>%
    summarize(Count = sum(Count), Native_Count = sum(Native_Count))

ggplot(global_lineage, aes(x = Tissue_Type, y = Count, fill = Lineage)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
    xlab("Tissue Type") +
    ylab("% Lineage") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = lineage_palette)

# ggsave("/projects/home/tlchan/fig_panels/supp_1e.pdf", width = 6, height = 8)

global_lineage %>% group_by(Tissue_Type) %>%
    mutate(total_cells = sum(Count)) %>% mutate(perc_cells = Count / total_cells) %>%
    write.csv("/projects/home/nealpsmith/projects/ascites/data/plot_data/fig_s1.csv", row.names = FALSE)


```

## Supplemental Figure 1G
```{r message = F, results = F, warning = F, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 8, supp_1G}
lineage_palette <- list("B/Plasma cells" = "#FF0029",
                        "CD4 T cells" = "#377EB8",
                        "CD8 T/NK cells" = "#66A61E",
                        "Dendritic cells" = "#984EA3",
                        "Mono/Macs" = "#00D2D5",
                        "Non-immune cells" = "#FF7F00")

global_lineage <- read.csv('/projects/home/tlchan/projects/ascites/results/abundance/w_peritoneal/global_lineage_counts.csv')

# Collapse tissue column
global_lineage <- global_lineage %>%
    group_by(Patient, Lineage) %>%
    summarize(Count = sum(Count), Native_Count = sum(Native_Count))

global_lineage <- global_lineage %>%
    mutate(cohort = ifelse(str_starts(Patient, "Pt"), "MGH", "Han")) %>%
    mutate(cohort = factor(cohort, levels = c("MGH", "Han"))) %>%
    mutate(Patient = factor(Patient, levels = mixedsort(unique(Patient))))

ggplot(global_lineage, aes(x = Patient, y = Count, fill = Lineage)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    facet_grid(~cohort, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
          strip.text = element_text(size = 22)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = lineage_palette)
# ggsave("/projects/home/tlchan/fig_panels/supp_1g.pdf", width = 12, height = 8)

write.csv(global_lineage, "/projects/home/nealpsmith/projects/ascites/data/plot_data/fig_s1f.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
